# katoptra.org

> katoptra.org has public mirrors of open-source software archives. Each mirror syncs from
> its upstream at scheduled times, with an open pipeline. Cloudflare's global network serves
> the mirrors. If upstream signs its tree, the pipeline verifies the mirror against the
> upstream's signatures and checksums. Because each mirror keeps the paths and the bytes of
> its upstream, the URL of a mirror here can replace the URL of its archive. Josh Vaughen
> (https://ijosh.com) operates the mirrors.

## Mirrors

- CTAN: https://ctan.katoptra.org/ (upstream: https://ctan.org, sync: hourly)
  It serves all the paths of CTAN at its root. Set the tlmgr repository to it:
  `tlmgr option repository https://ctan.katoptra.org/systems/texlive/tlnet/`
  Freshness: `https://ctan.katoptra.org/timestamp` (upstream's clock, year-month-day-hour-minute UTC).
- TeX Live (tlnet): https://tlnet.katoptra.org/ (upstream: https://ctan.org/tex-archive/systems/texlive/tlnet, sync: daily)
  It serves only the tlnet subtree, with all platforms. Set the tlmgr repository to it:
  `tlmgr option repository https://tlnet.katoptra.org/systems/texlive/tlnet/`
  Freshness: `https://tlnet.katoptra.org/timestamp` (upstream's clock, year-month-day-hour-minute UTC).
- GNU: https://gnu.katoptra.org/ (upstream: https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/, sync: twice a day)
  It serves all the paths of ftp.gnu.org/gnu at its root. These are the release tarballs
  and .sig signatures of more than 300 GNU packages (for example gcc, glibc, binutils,
  emacs, bash, coreutils and guix). The root also has gnu-keyring.gpg to verify them. It
  does not include alpha.gnu.org. Replace `https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/` or
  `https://ftpmirror.gnu.org/` with `https://gnu.katoptra.org/`, for example
  `https://gnu.katoptra.org/emacs/`.
  Freshness: `https://gnu.katoptra.org/mirror-updated-timestamp.txt` (upstream's Unix time).
- Savannah (nongnu): https://nongnu.katoptra.org/ (upstream: https://download.savannah.nongnu.org/releases/, sync: twice a day)
  It serves all the paths of download.savannah.nongnu.org/releases at its root. This is the
  same tree as download.savannah.gnu.org/releases: the release files of more than 1,000
  non-GNU projects on Savannah (for example freetype, acl, attr, dmidecode, lzip, nmh, quilt
  and tinycc). Replace `https://download.savannah.nongnu.org/releases/` with
  `https://nongnu.katoptra.org/`, for example `https://nongnu.katoptra.org/freetype/`.
  Freshness: `https://nongnu.katoptra.org/00_TIME.txt` (upstream's Unix time).

To go back to the CTAN mirror rotation from a TeX mirror here: `tlmgr option repository ctan`.

## Private mirrors

Two private mirrors copy the owner's accounts into Proton Drive. They have nothing public to
fetch.

- Dropbox, nightly: https://github.com/katoptra/dropbox
- GitHub, daily: https://github.com/katoptra/github

Their pipelines are open source. You can fork them to make mirrors of your accounts.

## Source

- The sync pipelines and this site: https://github.com/katoptra
